text: Sorry to trouble you, I'm not sure if I'm being silly. I'm looking after my granddaughter, she's 4, and she's got a fever but her hands and feet are ice cold and she's shivering a lot, I've put a blanket on her and it doesn't seem to help. And about twenty minutes ago she went stiff and was shaking all over and her eyes went up, I think it lasted maybe a minute or two? She's never done that before. Her neck seems alright I think, she can look down at her toes when I ask her. Her colour looks normal, lips aren't blue or anything. Sorry, I just don't know if I should be ringing someone
